summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd (India, NYSE-listed) furnished a Form 6-K attaching an 'Intimation dated July 23, 2026' — a routine corporate update of a foreign private issuer. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is described. The filing simply meets home-country exchange reporting obligations. As a standard periodic notification with no special-situation event, it falls outside all defined categories.
